changes: p2: removed residence 'Prayāgarāja' — the colophon gives Prayāga only as the place of copying, not as the scribe's home
p2: 'paṃºº' read as an abbreviation of paṇḍita; Tivārī kept as a surname/caste title
date: weekday normalised to Friday (bhṛguvāsara); added a note that the pakṣa is not given
notes: added the name variants and the date caveats

notes: The scribe's name is written 'giradhārīlāla', a vernacular spelling of Giridhārīlāla. The catalogue's 'Grirīdhārīlāla' is a misprint. 'paṃºº' abbreviates paṇḍita. The era is not named, but 'saṃvat 1913' copied at Prayāga is Vikrama Saṃvat, so VS 1913 Mārgaśīrṣa ≈ November–December 1856 CE. The pakṣa is not stated, so '9' may be the tithi of either fortnight. The weekday has not been verified. Gaṇapati is the author of the Ratnadīpa, not someone involved in making this copy.
